name: web_add_auto_filter
signature: int web_add_auto_filter([Action,]< List of Attributes >, LAST);
description: Sets filter criteria for downloading URLs (include or exclude) for subsequent action functions. Unlike web_add_filter, this filter remains active until removed with web_remove_auto_filter (use the ID attribute).

args.name: Action
args.desc: "Include" to include matching URLs, or "Exclude" (default) to skip matching URLs.

args.name: URL / UrlPrefix
args.desc: The exact URL, or a URL that starts with a given string.

args.name: Host / HostPrefix / HostSuffix
args.desc: Host name matching criteria.

args.name: Path / PathPrefix / PathSuffix
args.desc: URL path matching criteria.

args.name: Port
args.desc: The port number of the URL source.

args.name: Scheme
args.desc: The protocol: http, https, ftp.

args.name: Query / QueryPrefix / QuerySuffix
args.desc: Query string matching criteria.

args.name: FragmentId*
args.desc: Fragment identifier matching criteria.

args.name: ID
args.desc: The filter identifier, so that it can be removed with web_remove_auto_filter.

args.name: LAST
args.desc: Marks the end of the attribute list.

example:
web_add_auto_filter("Action=Exclude", "PathPrefix=/Images/Upload", LAST );

web_url("www.knanas.com", 
    "URL=http://www.knanas.com/", "Resource=0",
    "RecContentType=text/html", "Referer=", "Snapshot=t1.inf",
    "Mode=HTML", 
    EXTRARES,
    "Url=/images/netaction_icon.gif", 
    ENDITEM,
    "Url=http://frontpage.knanas.com/Images/Upload/Commerce323.jpg",
    ENDITEM,
    LAST );

name: web_add_auto_header
signature: int web_add_auto_header( const char *Header, const char *Content );
description: Adds a specified header to all subsequent HTTP requests in the script. Unlike web_add_header, which applies only to the next request. Does not apply in a concurrent group and is ignored by web_rest steps.

args.name: Header
args.desc: The header name, for example "Accept" or "Accept-Encoding".

args.name: Content
args.desc: The header value.

name: web_add_cookie
description: Adds, deletes, or replaces a script's temporary cookie (not a browser cookie). If a cookie with the same name and path already exists, it is overwritten; a cookie whose expiration date has passed is deleted. The domain attribute is required.

args.name: Cookie
args.desc: The cookie definition in the format name=VALUE; domain=DOMAIN_NAME; expires=DATE; path=PATH; secure.

args.name: name=VALUE
args.desc: Required: the cookie name and value.

args.name: domain
args.desc: Required: the domain name (use web_add_cookie_ex for an empty domain).

args.name: expires
args.desc: Optional: the expiration date.

args.name: path
args.desc: Optional: the cookie path, default "/".

args.name: secure
args.desc: Optional: the secure cookie flag.

name: web_add_cookie_ex
signature: int web_add_cookie_ex( const char *Cookie , [const char *Insert,][ const char *AllowEmptyDomain,] [ENDITEM, Cookie, [Insert,] [AllowEmptyDomain,] ] [ENDITEM...] LAST );
description: Adds a cookie with extra options: the insertion position in the cookie table and permission for an empty domain. Multiple cookie definitions can be specified in one call, separated by ENDITEM. Only the Cookie argument can be parameterized.

args.name: Cookie
args.desc: The cookie to add or modify, with elements like those of a Set-Cookie header.

args.name: Insert
args.desc: "Default" or "Alt"; "Alt" places the cookie first in the table.

args.name: AllowEmptyDomain
args.desc: "yes" allows an empty domain element; default is "no".

args.name: ENDITEM
args.desc: The separator between cookie definitions.

args.name: LAST
args.desc: Marks the end of the argument list (required).

example:
web_add_cookie_ex(
    "Cookie=client_id=China127B; path=/; expires=Wednesday, 09-Nov-2001 23:12:40 GMT; domain=",  
    "Insert=Alt",  
    "AllowEmptyDomain=yes",
    LAST );

name: web_add_filter
description: Sets criteria for including or excluding URLs when downloading, for the next action function only. For a persistent filter, use web_add_auto_filter.

args.name: Action
args.desc: "Include" to include matching URLs, or "Exclude" (default) to skip them.

args.name: URL / UrlPrefix
args.desc: The exact URL, or a URL that starts with a given string.

args.name: Host / HostPrefix / HostSuffix
args.desc: Host name matching criteria.

args.name: Path / PathPrefix / PathSuffix
args.desc: URL path matching criteria.

args.name: Port
args.desc: The port number of the URL source.

args.name: Scheme
args.desc: The protocol: http, https, ftp, and so on.

args.name: Query / QueryPrefix / QuerySuffix
args.desc: Query string matching criteria.

args.name: FragmentId*
args.desc: Fragment identifier matching criteria.

args.name: LAST
args.desc: Marks the end of the attribute list.

example:
web_add_filter("Action=Exclude", "PathPrefix=/Images/Upload", LAST);

web_url("www.knanas.com", "URL=http://www.knanas.com/", "Resource=0",
     "RecContentType=text/html", "Referer=", "Snapshot=t1.inf",
     "Mode=HTML",
     EXTRARES,
     "Url=/images/netaction_icon.gif", ENDITEM,
     "Url=http://frontpage.knanas.com/Images/Upload/Commerce323.jpg", ENDITEM,
     "Url=http://frontpage.knanas.com/Images/Upload/Commerce134.gif", ENDITEM,
     LAST);

name: web_add_header
signature: int web_add_header( const char *Header, const char *Content );
description: Adds a custom header to the next HTTP request only (one time). For a header that applies to all requests, use web_add_auto_header. Arguments support parameterization, the function is supported in a concurrent group, and it does not apply to web_rest steps.

args.name: Header
args.desc: The custom header name, for example "Accept".

args.name: Content
args.desc: The header value.

name: web_remove_auto_filter
description: Removes a download filter previously created with web_add_auto_filter, identified by the filter's ID.

args.name: Id
args.desc: The filter instance identifier, written as "Id=value".

args.name: LAST
args.desc: Marks the end of the attribute list.

example:
web_add_auto_filter("Action=Exclude",
     "PathPrefix=/Images/Upload", 
     "Id=fid",
     LAST );

web_url("www.knanas.com", "URL=http://www.knanas.com/", "Resource=0",
     "RecContentType=text/html", "Referer=", "Snapshot=t1.inf",
     "Mode=HTML", 
     EXTRARES,
     "Url=/images/netaction_icon.gif", ENDITEM,
     LAST );

web_remove_auto_filter("Id=fid", LAST );

name: web_remove_auto_header
description: Stops adding a specific user-defined header to subsequent requests, reversing web_add_auto_header. The ImplicitGen argument controls whether the implicit header is still generated.

args.name: Header
args.desc: The name of the user-defined header to stop, for example Content-Type, User-Agent.

args.name: Implicit
args.desc: "ImplicitGen=Yes/No/Cond": Yes = the implicit header is generated as before web_add_auto_header; No = it is not generated at all; Cond (default) = only if it was previously specified through web_add_auto_header.

args.name: LAST
args.desc: Marks the end of the argument list.

name: web_remove_cookie
description: Removes a specific cookie from the list of cookies available to the Vuser while the script runs. If only the cookie name is given (without path/domain), all cookies with that name are removed.

args.name: Cookie
args.desc: The name of the cookie to remove (no value is needed).

name: web_revert_auto_header
description: Stops adding a user-defined header to subsequent requests and restores implicit header generation as if web_add_auto_header/web_remove_auto_header had never been called. Equivalent to web_remove_auto_header with ImplicitGen=Yes.

args.name: Header
args.desc: The name of the user-defined header to stop, for example Content-Type, User-Agent, Referer.

name: web_cleanup_auto_headers
description: Stops adding all user-defined headers to subsequent HTTP requests, reversing the effect of web_add_auto_header. Takes no arguments.

name: web_cleanup_cookies
description: Deletes all cookies currently stored by the Vuser. Affects only the script's temporary cookies, not browser cookies. Takes no arguments.

name: web_cache_cleanup
description: Clears the contents of the simulator's cache. If the runtime setting "Simulate a new user each iteration" is enabled on the Browser Emulation tab, this function is called automatically at the start of each iteration.

name: web_dump_cache
signature: int web_dump_cache( const char *Name, const char *fileName, [ const char *Replace], LAST );
description: Saves the browser cache to a file for persistent caching; used together with web_load_cache so the same initial cache can be reused across runs. The ".cache" extension is added automatically and the destination folder must already exist.

args.name: Name
args.desc: The step label and automatic transaction name.

args.name: fileName
args.desc: The full or relative path of the cache file (supports parameterization), written as "FileName=...".

args.name: Replace
args.desc: "yes" (default) overwrites an existing file; "no" keeps it.

args.name: LAST
args.desc: Marks the end of the argument list.

name: web_load_cache
signature: int web_load_cache( const char *Name, const char *fileName, LAST );
description: Restores the browser cache from a file for persistent caching, so the same initial cache is used repeatedly in every run (reducing CPU load on the application and database servers). Used together with web_dump_cache.

args.name: Name
args.desc: The step label and automatic transaction name.

args.name: fileName
args.desc: The path of the cache file (absolute or relative, supports parameterization), written as "FileName=...".

args.name: LAST
args.desc: Marks the end of the argument list.

name: web_disable_keep_alive
description: Disables HTTP Keep-Alive (persistent) connections. Keep-Alive is enabled by default; when disabled, a separate TCP connection is created for each page element, which increases server load.

name: web_enable_keep_alive
description: Enables HTTP Keep-Alive connections so that a TCP connection can be reused to download multiple page elements. Enabled by default, and works only when both the browser and the server support it.

name: web_set_certificate
description: Makes the script use a specific certificate from the Internet Explorer certificate list when a secure server requests client authentication. This function is deprecated; use web_set_certificate_ex.

args.name: CertificateNumber
args.desc: A string with the position of the certificate in the Internet Explorer certificate list, for example "3".

name: web_set_certificate_ex
description: Sets the certificate attributes and key file for HTTPS requests that require a client certificate. A certificate can be cleared with CertFilePath=NULL.

args.name: CertFilePath
args.desc: The path of the certificate file (Sockets replay only).

args.name: CertFormat
args.desc: The certificate format: PEM or ASN1.

args.name: KeyFilePath
args.desc: The path of the certificate key file.

args.name: KeyFormat
args.desc: The key file format: PEM or ASN1.

args.name: Password
args.desc: The certificate password.

args.name: CertIndex
args.desc: A one-based index into the IE certificate database.

args.name: CertThumbprint
args.desc: The certificate thumbprint.

args.name: SendCertChain
args.desc: 1 to send the certificate chain; 0 (default) to not send it.

name: web_set_max_html_param_len
description: Sets the maximum length of an HTML string that can be captured and stored as a parameter (correlation, together with web_reg_save_param). The default is 256 characters; saving a string longer than the limit fails.

args.name: length
args.desc: The maximum length of the stored HTML string (must not exceed 4,294,967,295).

name: web_set_max_retries
description: Sets the maximum number of retries for Action steps. Retries are performed for HTTP 500-599 responses and network API errors, but not for timeouts or argument errors.

args.name: MaxRetries
args.desc: A string with the maximum number of retries; 0 means no retries (supports parameterization).

name: web_set_option
signature: int web_set_option( const char *OptionID, const char *OptionValue, LAST );
description: Sets a web option that affects all subsequent functions until it is changed again. Options are saved at the end of vuser_init and restored before each iteration.

args.name: DecodeContent
args.desc: Enables or disables decompression of server replies ("Yes"/"No").

args.name: DecodeContentForResources
args.desc: Controls decoding of resources to reduce CPU usage ("Yes"/"No").

args.name: DownloadNonHtmlResources
args.desc: Starts or stops downloading of images and non-HTML resources ("Yes"/"No").

args.name: LRW_OPT_DISPLAY_IMAGE_BODY
args.desc: Displays the request/response body of images ("Yes"/"No").

args.name: IgnoreCookieExpiresAttribute
args.desc: Ignores the cookie expires attribute ("Yes"/"No").

args.name: MaxRedirectionDepth
args.desc: The maximum redirection depth (a decimal number as a string).

args.name: LRW_OPT_NON_GUI_FRAMES_SCHEME_JAVASCRIPT
args.desc: Handles JavaScript frames in low-level scripts ("Yes"/"No").

args.name: LRW_OPT_HTML_CHAR_REF_BACKWARD_COMPATIBILITY
args.desc: Forces GUI-level character handling ("Yes"/"No").

name: web_set_pac
description: Sets the location of the proxy auto-configuration (PAC) script for HTTP requests. Proxy credentials from the Runtime Settings are ignored; call web_set_user before web_set_pac if the proxy requires authentication. An empty string "" disables PAC.

args.name: pacURL
args.desc: The URL of the PAC file (must be a URL, not a local path); "" to disable.

name: web_set_proxy
description: Routes all subsequent HTTP requests through a specified proxy server. The port is required because a proxy has no default port. An empty string "" bypasses the proxy and connects directly to the server.

args.name: proxy_host:port
args.desc: The proxy host and port, for example "proxy03.vision.net:8080" (supports parameterization); "" for a direct connection.

name: web_set_proxy_bypass
description: Specifies a list of URLs that are accessed directly, without going through the proxy. The list is not incremental: each call resets the previous setting, and an empty string clears all bypasses.

args.name: bypass1..n
args.desc: A semicolon-separated (;) list of "host:port" entries; "<local>" bypasses the proxy for all local/intranet hosts.

name: web_set_proxy_bypass_local
description: Specifies whether the proxy is bypassed for local (intranet) addresses, overriding the runtime setting "Do not use proxy server for local (intranet) addresses". If the proxy bypass string contains <local>, neither this function nor the UI option has any effect.

args.name: no_local
args.desc: "1" = bypass the proxy for local addresses, "0" = do not bypass (supports parameterization).

name: web_set_secure_proxy
description: Routes all subsequent HTTPS (SSL) requests through a specified secure proxy server. Works like web_set_proxy but for HTTPS traffic.

args.name: secure_proxy_host_port
args.desc: The secure proxy host and port in "host:port" format (the port is required; supports parameterization).

name: web_set_sockets_option
description: Sets socket-level options on the client machine. Supports socket-level replay in the Web HTML protocol (both HTML-based and URL-based scripts) and has no effect on WinInet-based replay.

args.name: ALLOW_ONLY_HOSTS
args.desc: Restricts requests to the listed servers only.

args.name: DISALLOW_HOSTS
args.desc: Blocks requests to specific servers (for example, ads).

args.name: SSL_CIPHER_LIST
args.desc: A colon-separated list of SSL ciphers.

args.name: SSL_VERSION
args.desc: The SSL/TLS version: 2, 3, TLS, TLS1.1, TLS1.2, TLS1.3, AUTO.

args.name: INITIAL_AUTH
args.desc: Sends credentials on the first request without waiting for a 401 (BASIC/NTLM/KERBEROS/NONE).

args.name: MAX_CONNECTIONS_PER_HOST
args.desc: The maximum number of concurrent connections per host (default 6).

args.name: SHUTDOWN_MODE
args.desc: The port shutdown behavior: GRACEFUL, FAST, or ABRUPT.

args.name: TRACE_SSL_IO
args.desc: Raw bit trace of the SSL connection.

args.name: USER_IP_ADDRESS
args.desc: The desired client IP address (IP spoofing).

args.name: OVERLAPPED_SEND
args.desc: 0 or 1 to disable/enable splitting of the "First Buffer".

name: web_set_timeout
description: Sets the maximum wait time (in seconds) for a specific operation during web testing. Both arguments support parameterization.

args.name: Action
args.desc: The operation type: CONNECT (establishing a connection to the server), RECEIVE (waiting for part of a response), or STEP (step timeout).

args.name: TimeOut
args.desc: The maximum wait time, in seconds.

name: web_set_user
signature: int web_set_user( const char *username, const char *password, const char *[realm\\]host:port );
description: Specifies login credentials for web server or proxy server authentication. Can be called multiple times for different servers, overrides the runtime proxy settings, and has no effect when a proxy autoconfiguration file is used.

args.name: username
args.desc: The user account name (maximum 127 characters).

args.name: password
args.desc: The user password (maximum 127 characters).

args.name: [realm\\]host:port
args.desc: The server and port (optionally "Realm\\server:port"); an empty string applies to all domains. Default ports: HTTP 80, HTTPS 443, FTP 21.
